name: branding-art-deco-wordmark-over-film-still
title: Art Deco Wordmark over Cinematic Portrait
whatItIs: A white condensed Art Deco style wordmark, 'THE CITIZEN'S', with tall thin letters, a small 'THE' above and playful shifted letterforms, laid across a grainy close-up of a face sipping a drink from a cut-crystal glass.
whatItMeans: The tall geometric letters evoke 1920s glamour while the dark grainy photograph adds intimacy and late-night mystery, promising a moody, upscale bar.
techniques: Tall condensed geometric caps with unexpected stroke terminals
Break the baseline slightly for personality and rhythm
White logo on very dark photo for maximum contrast
Crop the face at the eyes and glass so the type sits over the subject deliberately
Film grain and warm skin tones for tactile atmosphere

vocabulary.definition: Geometric, high-contrast, often tall and condensed letterforms inspired by 1920s design.
Visible noise texture that gives an image an analog feel.
A wordmark placed directly on a photograph rather than on a flat field.
